entries.wording: Parcel has been delivered
The parcel has returned to Sender
Shipment preparation
entries.note: The page prints this label where the posting date would be.

entries.wording: Shipment disposed of
Parcel redirected
The shipment is lost
The shipment was delivered to the Recipient.
entries.note: A scan on the history page, which also words it "The shipment has been delivered to the recipient." The recipient's acknowledgement after it is not kept.

entries.wording: The shipment is processed at sorting center.
entries.note: A scan on the history page at a sorting centre on the way, at the hub and again at the delivery depot.

entries.wording: The shipment has left the gateway in origin country.
entries.note: A scan on the history page as a parcel leaves a gateway, also on the way back to the sender after a failed delivery abroad.

entries.wording: The shipment couldn't be delivered because of bad/incorrect address and will be returned to the sender.
entries.note: A scan on the history page of a parcel sent abroad: the destination could not deliver it to the address given and sends it back, as the API's status then reads (ReturnToSender).

entries.wording: The recipient was informed about the date of delivery.
entries.note: A notice to the recipient on the history page before the delivery run; it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Delivery in the way to the DHL Point
entries.note: A scan on the history page between the delivery depot and the DHL BOX locker or DHL POP point that then holds the parcel.

entries.wording: Przesyłka w drodze do Punktu DHL POP
entries.note: The page's Polish for "Delivery in the way to the DHL Point".

entries.wording: Shipment is waiting in …
entries.note: A scan on the history page naming the DHL BOX locker or DHL POP point that holds the parcel for its recipient, with its address and opening hours: "Shipment is waiting in Automat DHL BOX 24/7: <address> Opening hours: …".

entries.wording: Przesyłka czeka na odbiór
entries.note: The status sentence the portal gives a parcel a DHL BOX locker or DHL POP point holds, while its timeline step is still For delivery: waiting for its recipient.

entries.wording: Shipment collected from DHL Parcelstation. . Thank you!
entries.note: A scan on the history page after the parcel waited in a DHL BOX locker: its recipient collected it.

entries.wording: Przesyłka została odebrana z Punktu DHL POP. Dziękujemy!
entries.note: The page's Polish for the recipient's collection, here from a DHL POP point.

entries.wording: The shipment is handled in Sorting Center
entries.note: A scan on the history page at a sorting centre on the way, the most frequent one.

entries.wording: Przesyłka jest obsługiwana w Centrum Sortowania
entries.note: The page's Polish for "The shipment is handled in Sorting Center" and "The shipment is processed at sorting center."

entries.wording: The shipment has arrives at sorting center.
entries.note: The arrival at a sorting centre, worded so on the page.

entries.wording: Przesyłka została przyjęta w centrum sortowania.
entries.note: The page's Polish for "The shipment has arrives at sorting center."

entries.wording: The shipment has reached DHL Terminal …
entries.note: A terminal named on the way, after the first one.

entries.wording: Przesyłka dotarła do oddziału DHL eCommerce …
entries.note: The page's Polish for "The shipment has reached DHL Terminal …", which translates some places too.

entries.wording: The shipment has reached DHL Terminal …. Delivery to the Recipient is expected today.
entries.note: The delivery depot, often followed by the hours the courier will come; another form says "on the next working day" and names no hours or place.

entries.wording: Przesyłka dotarła do Terminala DHL Parcel …. W dniu dzisiejszym zostanie przekazana Kurierowi DHL Parcel do doręczenia.
entries.note: The page's Polish for the delivery depot with delivery today, often followed by the hours.

entries.wording: Przesyłka dotarła do oddziału DHL eCommerce. Doręczenie do Odbiorcy planowane jest w kolejnym dniu roboczym.
entries.note: The page's Polish for the delivery depot with delivery on the next working day.

entries.wording: The shipment has arrived at delivery depot.
entries.note: The delivery depot, which the page may repeat on each day the parcel stays there.

entries.wording: Przesyłka przyjęta w oddziale doręczającym.
entries.note: The page's Polish for "The shipment has arrived at delivery depot."

entries.wording: According to consignee request the parcel will be delivered to the safe place.
entries.note: The recipient's instruction to leave the parcel in a safe place: it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Odbiorca złożył dyspozycję dot. doręczenia przesyłki do bezpiecznego miejsca doręczenia.
entries.note: The page's Polish for the safe-place instruction.

entries.wording: With delivery courier
entries.note: The courier has the parcel; the page sometimes ends it with a full stop.

entries.wording: Przesyłka przekazana kurierowi do doręczenia
entries.note: The page's Polish for "With delivery courier".

entries.wording: Przesyłka przekazana kurierowi do doręczenia. Przewidywane godziny doręczenia: 08:00-12:00.
entries.note: The courier's run with the hours it expects to come, the page's Polish for "With delivery courier. Expected delivery hours: …".

entries.wording: Przesyłka dotarła do oddziału nadawczego DHL Parcel ….
entries.note: The sending terminal named by its town, without a delivery day yet, at the minute of the parcel's first sorting there: the page's Polish for "The shipment has reached DHL terminal in ….".

entries.wording: Przesyłka dotarła do oddziału nadawczego DHL Parcel . Przewidywana data doręczenia do: 04-03-2026.
entries.note: A terminal on the way with the planned delivery day, its town left blank; it usually names the town before the full stop.

entries.wording: Przesyłka została doręczona do odbiorcy.
entries.note: The page's Polish for "The shipment has been delivered to the recipient."

entries.wording: DHL Courier did not reach the Recipient at the indicated delivery address. The shipment will be waiting for collection in DHL POP in the nearest area.
entries.note: The courier found nobody; a DHL POP point or locker nearby will hold the parcel.

entries.wording: Kurier DHL nie zastał Odbiorcy pod wskazanym adresem doręczenia. Przesyłka będzie oczekiwać na odbiór w Punkcie DHL POP / Automacie DHL POP BOX w najbliższej okolicy.
entries.note: The page's Polish for the courier finding nobody.

entries.wording: Przesyłka oczekuje na odbiór w …
entries.note: The page's Polish for "Shipment is waiting in …", followed by the point or locker's address and hours.

entries.wording: The Recipient has refused to accept the shipment and it will be returned to the Sender
entries.note: A return under way: the recipient refused the parcel.

entries.wording: Odbiorca odmówił przyjęcia przesyłki i zostanie ona zwrócona do Nadawcy
entries.note: The page's Polish for the recipient's refusal.

entries.wording: Shipment returned do sender. Time for receipt has passed
entries.note: A return under way: the parcel was not collected in time.

entries.wording: Zwrot przesyłki do nadawcy - minął termin odbioru
entries.note: The page's Polish for the uncollected parcel's return.

entries.wording: Delivery in the way to the Sender
entries.note: The return on its way to the sender.

entries.wording: Przesyłka w trakcie zwrotu do Nadawcy
entries.note: The page's Polish for the return on its way.

entries.wording: The shipment was returned to the Sender.
entries.note: The return's end, which the API words "The parcel has returned to Sender".

entries.wording: Przesyłka została zwrócona do nadawcy.
entries.note: The page's Polish for the return's end.
